items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: So Jack Kelson, he came in, and Jerry Dodgion, he was in town with that band from New York, Carnegie Hall.

ctx.x: It might have been three summers now that I come to think of it.

They had a memorial for him in New York and they had one here. And who should show up? Jackie Kelson showed up. The Basie band was laying over preparatory to going to Japan. So Jack Kelson, he came in, and Jerry Dodgion, he was in town with that band from New York, Carnegie Hall.
